instruction: How much have I paid in premium membership since I made the spotify account?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the only state-changing predicates are knowledge predicates. The answer (total paid for premium since account creation = sum over the full subscription history) is modeled as a single runtime amount object discovered by spotify.show_premium_subscriptions; at execution time the agent may need to page through results (page_index) and sum the amounts, which the reference solution does with an extra call. supervisor.complete_task takes the discovered amount as its answer and is forced to be last via (not (task-completed)) preconditions on all actions.
